# supplier-invoices/ (PRD-05 — extensions on core AP invoices)

Core CRUD for supplier invoices lives under `/api/accounting/bills/` and `/api/accounting/supplier-payments/`. This subtree holds workflow extensions (3/4-way match).

## Endpoints
- `GET /api/accounting/supplier-invoices/[id]/three-way-match` — cached match state (no recompute)
- `POST /api/accounting/supplier-invoices/[id]/three-way-match` — recompute match via service

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(...)))` wraps the single handler; GET tolerates the stricter gate.

## Request / Response
GET/POST response:
```
{ invoiceId, matchStatus, paymentMatched, paymentMatchedAt,
  itemResults: [{ itemId, itemDescription, quantity, unitPrice,
                  lineMatchStatus, qtyVariancePct, priceVariancePct, matchComputedAt }],
  summary: { totalLines, matchedLines, allLinesMatched } }
```

## Business rules
- `supplier_invoice_items` has **no `company_id`** column — tenancy joined through `supplier_invoices` (fixed 2026-04-22 500)
- GET reads cached columns `line_match_status`, `qty_variance_pct`, `price_variance_pct`, `match_computed_at`
- POST calls `performThreeWayMatch(companyId, invoiceId)`; service writes cache columns + `match_status`, `payment_matched`, `payment_matched_at`
- `allLinesMatched` true only when every line is `fully_matched` and there's ≥1 line
- Match tolerance config lives in company settings (qty_tolerance_pct, price_tolerance_pct)

## Related files
- `src/modules/accounting/services/ap/supplierInvoiceWorkflowService.ts` — `performThreeWayMatch`
- `src/modules/accounting/services/ap/` — core AP services (bills, payments, GRN)
